name: Buon Ma Thuot Coffee Festival
nameVi: Lễ hội Cà phê Buôn Ma Thuột
summary: Every two years in March, the coffee festival puts its main stage on October 10 Square, Quảng trường 10 tháng 3, with a street parade, coffee exhibitions, and a roasting contest. The ninth edition ran 9–13 March 2025, opening at 20:00 on 10 March and closing at 20:00 on 13 March.
when: 9–13 March 2025. Opening 20:00 on 10 March and closing 20:00 on 13 March at October 10 Square. Held every two years. Later dates: Check on arrival.
